rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects embedded configuration from Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 2e 72 63 64 2e 63 73 72 63 } // ".rcdata.csproj"
        $b = "beacon" fullword ascii
        $c = { 68 54 54 50 2f 31 2e 31 0d 0a 41 63 63 65 70 74 3a } // "HTTP/1.1..Accept:"
        $jarm = /0[0-9a-f]{2}d[0-9a-f]{64}/
    condition:
        all of them
}
